verdict.rationale: The plugin-marketplace docs say marketplaces provide "version tracking, automatic updates", and the anthropics/skills repo is officially registrable as a marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`), so installed skills get fixes without reinstalling. Plugins also carry a versioned manifest, and on the API side Skills take an optional `version` and have a Skill Versions API. The auto-update claim is a single line, though, with no detail on how or when updates apply, and no explicit update command is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented explicit update command, details of auto-update behavior and configuration, and hands-on or independent confirmation that updates actually arrive.
